questions.q: In Loiter the vehicle is “afraid” to fly backward even though it's empty there. What is the companion sending (an OBSTACLE_DISTANCE fragment)?
questions.fragment:
increment=5  angle_offset=0  min_distance=20  max_distance=1000  frame=BODY_FRD
distances[0..8]   = 412 398 377 ... (camera, forward sector)
distances[9..71]  = 0 0 0 0 0 ... 0
options: The sectors outside the field of view are filled with 0 instead of 65535 (no data) — the autopilot sees “an obstacle right next to it”
BODY_FRD rotates with the vehicle, and the “forward” sector moved to the back during a 180° turn
max_distance = 1000 cm is less than the camera range, so the rear sectors are considered occupied
increment = 5 gives only 72 sectors, while ArduPilot expects 360 at one degree each
questions.explain: “No data” is encoded as UINT16_MAX; 0 does not mean “unknown”.
